strongest_angle: Investigative findings reveal that Deloitte Cyprus systematically falsified corporate records to help Roman Abramovich hide billions in assets and evade tax obligations.

key_facts.fact: Deloitte Cyprus and its spin-off firm Meritservus falsified at least 1,000 corporate documents to assist Roman Abramovich in hiding assets.
Accounts signed off by Deloitte in Cyprus resulted in assets including superyachts, mansions, and private jets worth $672 million disappearing from Roman Abramovich's company records.
Deloitte staff in Cyprus utilized fake timestamps to retroactively rewrite historical records before the firm acted as an independent auditor to sign off on accounts.

numbers.label: Value of assets hidden from accounts
